title: Dynamics of dissipative periodic optical waves in an external potential
summary: We study the dynamics of periodic waves in a damped-driven nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation perturbed by a small spatially dependent transport term. This equation arises in nonlinear optics as a model for light propagation in a passive optical cavity driven by a bichromatic laser source.
